cols=[];names=[]

# greedy backward elimination on significant terms
act=list(range(len(names)))

    cc,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X[:,a],sigma,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((X[:,a]@cc-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma), cc

def equation(eps, T, params):
